method: Read route roots and recursively follow local/@ imports, then identify named Dialog/Modal/Menu/Drawer/Popover/Panel consumers and manual workflow branches. Import reachability does not prove active conditional rendering.
limitations: Named component and workflow-group entries intentionally overlap to preserve nested traceability; do not sum them as independent tested workflows.
Generic DS wrappers and ordinary selection fields are covered through parent states, not counted as unique nested business surfaces.
Conditional fixture branches need existing data; no records manufactured.
